title: Culinary Journey Through Santorini: A Food Lover's 2026 Guide
metaDescription: Taste the best of Santorini. From street food to fine dining, this guide covers the culinary highlights every foodie must experience.
excerpt: Santorini is a food lover's paradise. The flavors, aromas, and textures of Greece's cuisine will take you on an unforgettable culinary journey.
author: Wanderlust Team
content:
There is something about Santorini that captures the imagination of travelers worldwide. For those chasing culinary experiences in Santorini, this guide will show you the best of what awaits.

## Must-Try Dishes

- Signature street food that locals eat daily
- Traditional dishes passed down through generations
- Regional specialties unique to Santorini
- Modern interpretations of classic Greece cuisine

![Food in Santorini](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1678266561093-324802646fb2?fm=webp&w=1200&q=60)

## Best Food Experiences

Night markets in Santorini are a feast for the senses, with stall after stall of sizzling, aromatic dishes.

## Dining Tips

- Ask locals for recommendations — they know the best hidden spots
- Try the daily specials at local restaurants for authentic flavors
- Visit markets early in the morning for the freshest produce
- Do not be afraid to try unfamiliar dishes — surprises are often the best
